rationale: Create one canonical Chief Power platform record rather than separate records for its financing, holding-company and plant-owner subsidiaries. ArcLight Energy Partners Fund V formed the platform in 2014 to acquire partial interests in the Keystone and Conemaugh generating stations and added a separately financed tranche in 2019. A 2020 lender restructuring transferred control of the original Chief Power Finance tranche, but Fund V retained a small voting interest and the separately owned Chief Power Finance II tranche was expressly excluded. A 2024 FERC filing states that Fund V still indirectly owns greater than 10% voting interests in both II plant-owner entities, ArcLight's current investments page continues to label Chief Power current, and the platform continues to be asset-managed as an approximately 1,300 MW ownership position. No later ArcLight exit, signed sale or pending ownership change was identified through August 13, 2026.

afterImage.name: Chief Power
afterImage.description: Chief Power is an ArcLight Energy Partners Fund V-backed merchant-generation platform holding partial tenant-in-common interests in the Keystone and Conemaugh coal-fired generating stations in western Pennsylvania. ArcLight established the platform in 2014 and expanded it through a separately financed acquisition in 2019. After a 2020 lender restructuring transferred control of the original tranche, Fund V retained a small minority voting interest and continued to control the separately owned Chief Power Finance II tranche. Current public filings identify Fund V as holding greater than 10% voting interests in each II plant-owner entity, while the exact Fund V economic percentage is not publicly disclosed. Chief Power is the single PortCo; its financing entities, transfer parent, plant-owner subsidiaries and the two jointly owned generating stations are not separate portfolio companies.

Chief Power acquired additional minority interests, increasing its original tranche to 44.45% of Keystone and 35.11% of Conemaugh.
ArcLight's separately financed Chief II entities completed the acquisition of PSEG's 22.84% Keystone and 22.5% Conemaugh interests.

A lender restructuring transferred control of the original Chief Power Finance tranche to Chief Power Transfer Parent; Fund V retained a small interest subsequently reported at approximately 3%, while the separate Chief Power Finance II tranche remained outside the transfer and under ArcLight control.
